skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the purpose, meaning, econometric methods, types of data, and variables.
Understand the Ordinary Least Squares estimation method, its assumptions, and properties.
Understand how to interpret model coefficients, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and model diagnostics.
Apply regression analysis techniques including simple and multiple regressions, logarithmic transformations, polynomial functions, dummy variables, trend variables, and lagged variables.
Conduct time series analysis using appropriate models and techniques.
Collect and manage data for econometric modeling.
Use statistical software such as EViews and R for econometric analysis.
Analyze and interpret econometric results critically.
Apply econometric models to solve economic, financial, and business problems.
Work collaboratively in teams on econometric projects.
Engage in independent learning and research.
